title: ReliableRAG: Combating Misinformation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Reliability-Guided Reasoning Chains
abstract: arXiv:2608.25487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful architecture for Question Answering (QA) by integrating external information into Large Language Models (LLMs). However, false, inaccurate, and misleading information in news and social media poses a serious challenge to real-world RAG systems, especially in multi-hop QA, where complex multi-step reasoning can be misled by even a single deceptive misinformation segment in the retrieved documents. Existing approaches mainly rely on implicit alignment or explicit regulation, but their limited ability to assess fine-grained information reliability makes them vulnerable to deceptive misinformation that is semantically relevant to the question yet factually incorrect, leading to erroneous answers. To address this limitation, we propose ReliableRAG, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first reliability-driven framework that mitigates deceptive misinformation in multi-hop QA

translated_title: 可靠RAG：通过可靠性引导的推理链对抗检索增强生成中的错误信息
translated_abstract: 摘要：检索增强生成（RAG）已成为一种强大的问答（QA）架构，通过将外部信息整合到大型语言模型（LLMs）中。然而，新闻和社交媒体中的虚假、不准确和误导性信息对现实世界的RAG系统构成了严重挑战，尤其是在多跳问答中，复杂的多步推理可能被检索文档中的单一欺骗性错误信息片段所误导。现有方法主要依赖隐式对齐或显式调节，但它们在评估细粒度信息可靠性方面的能力有限，使其容易受到与问题语义相关但事实错误的欺骗性错误信息的影响，从而导致错误答案。为解决这一限制，我们提出了ReliableRAG，据我们所知，这是首个在多跳问答中缓解欺骗性错误信息的可靠性驱动框架。
tldr: 本文提出了ReliableRAG，这是首个利用可靠性引导的推理链来对抗多跳问答中欺骗性错误信息的框架，通过细粒度可靠性评估提升了RAG系统的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ReliableRAG, the first reliability-driven framework that mitigates deceptive misinformation in multi-hop QA via reliability-guided reasoning chains, enhancing RAG robustness through fine-grained reliability assessment.
